title: The Distributional Tail of Worst-Case Quickselect
summary: We study the almost surely finite random variable $S$ defined by the distributional fixed-point equation \[ S \stackrel{d}{=} 1 + \max\{US', (1-U)S''\}, \qquad U \sim \mathrm{Unif}(0,1), \] where $S'$ and $S''$ are independent copies of $S$, independent of $U$. This random variable arises as the almost sure limit of the normalized worst-case number of key comparisons used by classical Quickselect with uniformly chosen pivots in the model of Devroye.
